summary: The compact/--agent list projection always keeps the Steam demo annotation fields (steam_app_id, has_demo, demo_app_ids) plus the demo-row identity fields (app_id, parent_app_id, parent_name), even when they are absent on most rows.
reason: A fresh print's compactListFields keeps only high-gravity keys plus keys present in >=80% of rows. The --with-demos annotation is omitempty and genuinely sparse (a row is annotated only when its Steam record resolved, and demo_app_ids only when that app has demos), so a regen reintroduces the bug where `discover --with-demos --agent` prints has_demo but drops demo_app_ids and `similar ... --agent` drops both. The keep-set is deliberately limited to the Steam/demo payload names, which no unrelated command emits, so default (no --with-demos) compaction is unchanged.
validated_outcome: Offline tests pass: discover --with-demos --agent keeps steam_app_id/has_demo/demo_app_ids on every Steam-linked row and demo_app_ids on the demo row; the same fields survive the printJSONFiltered path similar uses; default discover --agent output is byte-for-byte identical to the HEAD 1a45fcf3d golden.
